name: rank_assets_by_exposure
description: Rank individual infrastructure assets by exposure severity, usually from an infrastructure exposure layer or asset-hazard sample layer.

input_artifact.description: Required infrastructure exposure artifact or asset-hazard sample artifact containing one GeoJSON feature per asset.

value_column.description: Numeric column used for ranking. If omitted, the function tries exposure_difference, sampled_hazard_value, hazard_value, risk_score, exposure_score, then input_artifact.value_column.

asset_name_column.description: Optional asset name column. If omitted, common fields like asset_name, name, facility_name, school_name, hospital_name, port_name, or substation_name are inferred.

asset_id_column.description: Optional stable asset ID column. If omitted, common fields like asset_id, id, facility_id, school_id, hospital_id, port_id, substation_id, or osm_id are inferred.

asset_type_column.description: Optional infrastructure type/category column. If omitted, common fields like asset_type, type, category, sector, or class are inferred.

direction.description: Ranking direction. Use highest/top/worst/most for largest values, or lowest/bottom/best/least for smallest values.

top_n.description: Number of ranked assets to return. If null, return all ranked assets unless include_all_assets is false.

include_all_assets.description: If true, return all assets with numeric ranking values, not only the top_n.

include_missing_assets.description: If true, include assets with missing ranking values at the bottom as unranked_missing_value.

return_geometry_format.description: Geometry output format. Currently only GeoJSON is supported.

artifact_type.description: Usually asset_exposure_ranking_layer. Can also be asset_exposure_ranking_failed.

input_artifact_type.description: Artifact type of the input asset layer.

input_layer_id.description: Layer ID of the input artifact.

layer_id.description: Generated layer ID for the ranked asset output.

value_column.description: Main downstream value column. Usually asset_rank_score.

source_value_column.description: Original numeric column used for ranking.

geojson.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection with ranked asset features.

asset_count.description: Number of assets in the original input artifact.

ranked_asset_count.description: Number of returned assets with numeric ranking values.

missing_value_count.description: Number of original assets with missing ranking values.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minx, miny, maxx, maxy].

summary.description: Overall asset ranking summary, including top asset and value statistics.

provenance.description: Information about ranking method, ranking column, direction, and parent artifact.
